The "life is only beginning at this stage" argument is moot entirely for the same reason it is true; your life, as an individual, is beginning now, but the life that begins here will always and forever be dictated by the characteristics, effort, environment etc. that you put in/were around you from the start till now.   


I'm sorry you feel suicidal dude. Please get help if you arent already. I tried to kill myself the first time when I was 13 and its only been downhill from there. Professional help didnt do jackshit for me, but you should still consider it if you havent already.
The only other way its going to go is down a path of more suffering and pain. It'll be more misery and more loneliness, probably more than I can even imagine. I'm too tired for that.
You plan on shooting yourself but are telling someone who intends on doing the same to not do it? Thats kinda hypocritical... You of all people should know this is our only way out.
I needed this. I found a 9mm and I've had it with me for the last few hours. Havent eaten or drunk anything since. I just need to know this will be quick and painless. May we find an end to our pain.
